title: Audit complete binary AtomSwap and Sign costs
body:
PR2501 adds binary AtomSwap and address Sign primitives outside PR2473's earlier ADD audit. This contribution supplies an independent exact read/write/head-movement oracle for the new digit buckets, a complete source-loop proof of their C_q*w*V bound including binary preparation and cleanup, and a reusable tape-role lifetime schedule. No predecessor defect was found; the swap/sign algorithms and prior big-O claim remain credited to PR2501.

For a complete digit swap the measured source bill is bounded by (93V reads, 27V writes, 106V moves), including counter input-word traffic, blank tests and every head return. The full atom/sign bound has an explicit conservative q-dependent constant. Unequal spectators, the S=1 shortcut, source preservation, owned output and scratch erasure are part of the contract. A written reused-lane schedule uses q²+8 tape roles and at most six extra numerical words; it is not a literal machine compiler or Python heap bound.

Validation: native CPython 3.12.7 registered optimized replay and all four export-test groups pass; CPython 3.14.5 optimized primary reproduces the complete receipt. Evidence covers 126 exact digit bills, 14 complete bit-origin maps, 18 cardinality cases, five binary divisions including 522-bit inputs, and eight semantic/billing controls. Git-free read-only export and actual source, numerical/type receipt, duplicate/missing receipt and overwrite faults are checked. Independent separate-agent review passed at the exact submitted head: source formulas and lifetimes, the explicit all-size preparation conversion, all registered checks, 36 additional Counter boundary/padding cases, and three extra complete bit-origin macro cases. All 18 tracked files are hash-bound in the review receipt.

Reproduce: `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/binary-digit-cost-audit`.

Exact source pins: Jose Manuel / jmbarrancoml PR2501 at 52a995b9d7f3e008c252770a5f47fde67a7cb37a and ywz65 PR2473 at 677baf4c92e876530c9637db191e5fd92f62624f. Retained source bytes, SHA256/Git-blob pins and predecessor notices are included. The Counter lifetime lemma is reused and credited, with an explicit canonical-one-bit extension.

Starts directly from fresh canonical main 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2, priority revision 4; both predecessor heads remained unchanged at final checking. TASK records the changed bit-helper-contract scope, picker/control, cached complete overlap plus bounded fresh REST supplementation, and the quota-limited Discussion coverage. Canonical claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2501#issuecomment-6194273149.

This is a primitive cost/ownership audit. Complete residual composition, coefficient pages, directories, recursive children, global hosting and supplier admission remain open. No new kappa, selected cold replay, hosted CI, human review or formal-kernel verification is claimed. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
